pr_title: fix: Fix for `set_operations` of binary dtype

issue_context.title: 0.20.6 regression from 0.20.5: `list.set_intersection()` panics for columns of type `pl.List[Binary]`
issue_context.body:
### Checks

- [X] I have checked that this issue has not already been reported.
- [X] I have confirmed this bug exists on the [latest version](https://pypi.org/project/polars/) of Polars.

### Reproducible example

This code works on 0.20.5 but breaks on 0.20.6:

```python
import polars as pl


df = pl.DataFrame(
    {
        'before': [[b'123', b'456'], [b'123', b'456'], [b'123', b'456']],
        'after': [[b'123', b'789'], [b'123', b'789'], [b'123', b'789']],
    }
)

df.select(pl.col.before.list.set_intersection(pl.col.after))
```

### Issue description

it worked before on 0.20.5, now it doesn't

### Expected behavior

works same as 0.20.6

### Installed versions

0.20.5 --> 0.20.6
